# ROOT is the country that acts, FROM the one it acts on. The AI never sends these (EU4).

# Concord of the Remnant (Enchantment IV): an elven or Ruinborn country's opinion and trust
DA_EL_concord_action = {
	category = influence
	require_acceptance = no
	is_visible = {
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.EL_Enc4
		FROM = { DA_EL_kin = yes }
	}
	is_allowed = {
		treasury = 300
		DA_EL_has_lore = { amount = 10 }
		DA_EL_rested.concord = yes
	}
	on_accept = {
		add_treasury = -300
		DA_EL_pay_lore = { amount = 10 }
		FROM = { add_opinion = { who = ROOT modifier = DA_EL_concord } add_trust = { who = ROOT value = 20 } }
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_EL_cd.concord set_country_flag = DA_EL_cd.concord }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		always = no
	}
}

# Guide the Elves (the Ruinborn): our wayfinders guide an elven country's next expedition
DA_EL_guide_action = {
	category = influence
	require_acceptance = no
	is_visible = {
		DA_EL_is_ruinborn = yes
		DA_EL_level_at.2 = yes
		FROM = { DA_RH_primary_elven = yes }
	}
	is_allowed = {
		DA_EL_rested.guide = yes
	}
	on_accept = {
		add_treasury = 100
		FROM = { add_opinion = { who = ROOT modifier = DA_EL_guided } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_EL_guide_eff_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			FROM = { set_country_flag = DA_RX_guided }
			clr_country_flag = DA_EL_cd.guide
			set_country_flag = DA_EL_cd.guide
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		always = no
	}
}
